lines.text: David lives in a house of cedar while the ark is under a tent, and Nathan tells him to do all that is in his heart.
That night God tells Nathan that David will not build Him a house, since God has moved from tent to tent since Egypt.
God says He took David from following the army to rule Israel, and He will make him a great name.
God promises to raise up one of David's sons, who will build a house for Him, and He will never remove His loving devotion from him.
David sits before the LORD and asks who he is, then says God went out to redeem Israel from Babylon.
